title: Schedule for Pro Forma Sessions and Monday November 9, 2026
body:
The Senate stands adjourned for Pro Forma sessions only with no business conducted on the following dates and times:

Thursday, October 1 st at 10:30am

Monday, October 5 th at 4:00pm

Tuesday, October 6 th at 1:30pm

Friday, October 9 th at 1:30pm

Tuesday, October 13 th at 3:30pm

Thursday, October 15 th at 9:30am

Monday, October 19 th at 9:00am

Thursday, October 22 nd at 9:00am

Monday, October 26 th at 5:30pm

Thursday, October 29 th at 2:00pm

Monday, November 2 nd at 4:30pm

Thursday, November 5 th at 10:30am

Notwithstanding the Senate’s adjournment, reports of committees and introduction of measures will be authorized on Thursday, October 15 th from 10:00am until 11:00am.

When the Senate adjourns on Thursday, November 5 th , it will stand adjourned until 3:00pm on Monday, November 9, 2026.

Following Leader remarks, the Senate will resume consideration of the motion to proceed to Cal. #453 , H.R.2347 Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act.

At approximately 5:30pm, the Senate will vote on the motion to invoke cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #453 , H.R.2347 .

Monday, November 9 th at approx. 5:30pm – 1 roll call vote:

Motion to invoke cloture on motion to proceed to Cal. #453 , H.R.2347 – Survivor Justice Tax Prevention Act

title: Schedule for Wednesday, September 30, 2026
body:
The Senate stands adjourned until 10:15am on Wednesday, September 30, 2026.

Following Leader remarks, the Senate will be in a period of morning business with senators permitted to speak therein for up to ten minutes each.

During Monday’s session, Senator Thune filed cloture on the following:

Motion to proceed to Cal. #548 H.R.7008 , Stop Insider Trading Act

Motion to proceed to Cal. #684 H.R.9340 , Ratepayer Protection Act

Executive Calendar #912 Keith Sonderling, of Florida, to be Secretary of Labor

At approximately 11:30am, the Senate will vote on the motion to invoke cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #548 H.R.7008 , Stop Insider Trading Act. If cloture is not invoked, the Senate will vote on the motion to invoke cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #684 , H.R.9340 Ratepayer Protection Act. If cloture is not invoked, the Senate will vote on the motion to invoke cloture on Executive Calendar #912 Keith Sonderling, of Florida, to be Secretary of Labor.

Additional roll call votes are possible during Wednesday’s session.

Wednesday, September 30 th at approx. 11:30am – up to 3 roll call votes:

Motion to invoke cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #548 H.R.7008 , Stop Insider Trading Act

Motion to invoke cloture on the motion to proceed to Cal. #684 , H.R.9340 , Ratepayer Protection Act

Motion to invoke cloture on Executive Calendar #912 Keith Sonderling, of Florida, to be Secretary of Labor

title: Schedule for Tuesday, September 29, 2026
body:
The Senate stands adjourned as a further mark of respect to the memory of former Senator Nancy Kassebaum until 10:00am on Tuesday, September 29, 2026.

Following Leader remarks, the Senate will be in a period of Morning Business with Senators permitted to speak therein for up to 10 minutes each.

The Senate will recess from 12:30pm until 2:15pm to allow for weekly caucus meetings.

If Senator Baldwin or her designee makes a motion to proceed to Cal. #456 , S.J.Res.197 , A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services of the Department of Health and Human Services relating to "Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, HHS Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters for 2027; and Basic Health Program”, the Senate will vote on the motion at 2:15pm.

During Monday’s Session Senator Thune filed cloture on the following items:

Motion to proceed to Cal. #548 H.R.7008 Stop Insider Trading Act

Motion to proceed to Cal. #684 , H.R.9340 Ratepayer Protection Act

Executive Calendar #912 Keith Sonderling, of Florida, to be Secretary of Labor

Tuesday, September 29 at 2:15pm – 1 roll call vote expected:

Motion to proceed to Cal. #456 , S.J.Res.197 - A joint resolution providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services of the Department of Health and Human Services relating to "Patient Protection and Affordable Care Act, HHS Notice of Benefit and Payment Parameters for 2027; and Basic Health Program"

title: Schedule for Monday, September 28, 2026
body:
The Senate stands adjourned until 3:00pm on Monday, September 28, 2026.

Following Leader remarks, the Senate will resume consideration of Cal. #449 S.4668 , Protect College Sports Act, as amended, post-cloture.

The post-cloture time from 4:00pm to 5:30pm is be equally divided between the proponents and opponents of the bill, with the opponent time under the control of Senator Booker.

At approximately 5:30pm, absent further agreement, the Senate will vote on passage of the bill as amended.

Monday, September 28 th at approx. – absent further agreement, roll call vote:

Passage of Cal. #449 S.4668 , Protect College Sports Act, as amended

title: Schedule for Thursday, September 24, 2026
body:
The Senate stands adjourned until 10:00am on Thursday, September 24, 2026.

Following Leader remarks, the Senate will resume consideration of Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 , post-cloture, to Cal. #449 S.4668 , Protect College Sports Act.

At approximately 10:45am, the Senate will vote on adoption of Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 . Following disposition of the amendment, the Senate will vote on cloture on the bill, as amended, if amended.

Additional roll call votes are possible during Thursday’s session.

Thursday, September 24 th at approx. 10:45am – 2 roll call votes expected:

Adoption of Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776

Motion to invoke cloture on, Cal. #449 S.4668 , Protect College Sports Act, as amended, if amended

title: Schedule for Wednesday, September 23, 2026
body:
The Senate stands adjourned until 10:00am on Wednesday, September 23, 2026.

Following Leader remarks, the Senate will resume consideration of Cruz-Cantwell substitute amendment #6776 , post-cloture, to Cal. #449 S.4668 , Protect College Sports Act.

All time all time during recess, adjournment, morning business, and Leader remarks count post-cloture on the substitute amendment.

The Senate will recess from 12:30pm until 2:15pm to allow for the weekly caucus meetings.

At approximately 2:15pm, the Senate will vote on confirmation of Executive Calendar #828 Angela Veronica Colmenero, of Texas, to be United States District Judge for the Southern District of Texas.

Additional roll call votes are possible during Wednesday’s session.

Wednesday, September 23 rd at approx. 2:15pm – roll call vote:

Confirmation of Executive Calendar #828 Angela Veronica Colmenero, of Texas, to be United States District Judge for the Southern District of Texas
